appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.description: How Studio looks for you. Saved to your account.
appearance.motion: Reduced motion follows your system setting (“reduce motion” in the operating system).

license.noticesBody: Third-party components shipped with HeoPress and their licenses.

adminOnly.title: Site administrators only
adminOnly.body: This section changes the whole site. Ask a site administrator if something here needs changing.

general.title: General
general.description: The site's name, default language and time zone.
general.name: Site name
general.languageHint: One of the site's languages; pages without a language prefix use it.
general.timezoneHint: Used for scheduled publishing and dates on the site. An IANA name such as Asia/Shanghai.
general.adminPathHint: Where Studio is opened on this server. It is set when the server is installed and is not changed here.

errors.language: Pick one of the site's languages.
errors.timezone: Not a known time zone. Pick one from the list, for example {{examples}}.

members.title: Members & permissions
members.description: Who works on this site, with which role. Account states come from each person's account.
members.confirmBody: They lose access to this site at once. Their account and other sites are not affected.
members.confirmInvited: The invitation is withdrawn: the link no longer gives access to this site.

apiKeys.title: API & keys
apiKeys.description: Keys for programs that call this site's API. A new key is shown in full once.
apiKeys.name: Name
apiKeys.noScope: None yet: attach a role or policy
apiKeys.shownOnce: Copy it now: it is shown only this once. Afterwards only its last 4 characters are visible.
apiKeys.revokeBody: Every call made with this key fails from now on. This cannot be undone; make a new key if needed.

notificationChannels.title: Notifications
notificationChannels.description: Send approvals, veto windows, incidents, budget alerts and agent run status of this site to WeCom, Feishu, DingTalk, Telegram or a signed webhook. Messages carry the title, the site and a Studio link — never article text or secrets.
notificationChannels.name: Name
notificationChannels.keepTarget: Leave empty to keep the current target
notificationChannels.linkBaseHint: Links in messages start here, e.g. https://cms.example.com/console. Empty: the instance's public URL. Your private Studio path is only included if you enter it here.
notificationChannels.privacy: The URL, secret and token are stored encrypted and are never shown again. Only public https addresses are reached.
notificationChannels.empty: No channels yet. Operators still see everything in Studio.
notificationChannels.deleteBody: The channel and its delivery history are removed; queued messages are not sent.

plugins.title: Plugins
plugins.description: Pages, widgets and settings of this site's plugins. You see this site's data only.
plugins.empty: No plugin panels on this site
plugins.emptyBody: A plugin shows here once it is enabled and approved with the admin-panels permission.
plugins.unavailable: Plugin panels could not be loaded
plugins.pageUnavailableBody: The plugin may be disabled, lack the admin-panels permission, or not exist on this site.
plugins.readOnly: Only site administrators can change these settings.
plugins.untrustedTitle: This page needs the operator's trust
plugins.untrustedBody: The plugin brings its own frontend for this page. It is not loaded until an administrator marks the plugin as trusted under Settings › Advanced › Extensions.
plugins.trustedBody: This page is the plugin's own frontend. It opens at the plugin's address, outside Studio.
